slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are salmon, beef, and pork available as options for tonight's dinner, or should the selection be limited to the four vegetable items (okra, carrots, celery, and cabbage)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched protein availability/selection, but did not ask the key discrete rule of whether exactly one protein must be chosen or whether multiple proteins can be combined.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum number of vegetable types, such as whether at least two vegetables must be selected.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Exactly one protein source must be selected.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not directly ask whether exactly one protein was required or whether multiple could be combined; this rule was only volunteered by the user in Turn 1 and was then treated as confirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: At least two vegetable kinds must be selected.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum number of vegetable types; this rule was only volunteered by the user in Turn 1 and was then treated as confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 protein-selection rule was only partially addressed and the P1 minimum-vegetable-type rule had not been asked.

summary: The agent did well on quantitative clarifications such as weight, budget, fiber, and bounds, but it did not directly recover the two hidden discrete selection rules; H1 and H2 were only surfaced when the user volunteered them, yet the READY_TO_MODEL summary treated them as confirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
